score_notes.novelty: requestIdleCallback as a paint source — browser's confessed idle time becomes the length of every stroke — is a fresh web-native found-object the catalogue has never touched, paired with a dual-gate (CPU-idle AND hand-still) the mechanism cannot exist without.
score_notes.nuance: concept = execution cleanly (the painting can only be made by idleness at both ends of the glass) and the surface gag lands without the wall text; the literate reading (attention economy inversion, Stilinović's lazy aesthetics, Duchamp's withdrawal) is carried by the status messages and data plate and only modestly amplified by the label.
score_notes.narrative: explicitly answers y-a-v-a's own 1000 Hours of Staring and The Artist Is Present by inverting their attention-as-medium logic into its absence, sits legibly on the chance/order axis (non-deterministic idle timing vs strict row-by-row strokes), and stakes the Stilinović/Lozano/Duchamp lineage for the current attention moment.
score_notes.craft: single file, no frameworks, no assets, no requests; feature-detection for unsupported browsers is honest and graceful; the data plate, status strings and wall label all carry weight and nothing is decorative.
score_notes.wit: 'You are doing nothing. The painting is being made.' and the 'Laziness, here, is unavailable' fallback line are deadpan gems; the joke lands on the surface and re-lands when you notice the productivity scheduler has been quietly repurposed to waste time beautifully.

references_named: Mladen Stilinović, In Praise of Laziness (1993)
rationale: A coherent and well-executed piece that takes Mladen Stilinović's claim literally at both the CPU and the viewer's hand: requestIdleCallback's timeRemaining() becomes stroke length while a stillness gate withholds paint until the hand has lain untouched for 400ms. The mechanism enacts the idea (P1), the chance/order axis is legible in the timing-vs-rows split (P5), and the ethical defaults are honored (P8). It extends the y-a-v-a thread on attention-as-medium by inverting it into its absence, answering 1000 Hours of Staring and The Artist Is Present from the catalogue.
reservations: The wall text runs long for a piece that should prize minimal gesture (P3); a stricter cut could let the data plate and status strings carry more of the literate reading.
revision_suggestion: Slim the wall label to the Stilinović quote, the licence and one short sentence; let the 'moments you held still / moments you stirred' counter do the arguing about attention rather than spelling it out.
